summary.text: Stephanie Gricius is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 50, in office since 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
An entrepreneur from Eagle Mountain, she served on the Eagle Mountain City Council from 2015 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Gricius lives in Eagle Mountain, Utah.
Her career has included owning and operating a small custom manufacturing company with her husband, Chris, and working as a realtor.
She was elected to the Eagle Mountain City Council in 2015 and served until 2020, and she joined the Utah House in 2023, succeeding Susan Pulsipher.
